sentences.english_text: Where he was, was the war room of the United States Defense Department.
The war room is one of the most secret rooms in the world.
In it are dozens of huge computers that control North America's war missiles and atomic weapons.
The computers keep track of enemy submarines and warplanes and missiles.
They're programmed so that if an enemy attack is launched on the United States, the missiles immediately launch a counter-attack against the enemy.
The room is so secret that in order to get into it, you have to pass seven security checks.
The computers were so sensitive that the room in which they operated had to be kept at a certain temperature day and night.
No drinks were allowed in the computer room, because if moisture ever got into the computers, they would malfunction.
Now, you know all this, and I know all this, but Drippy knew none of this.
All he knew was that there were a lot of huge-looking machines all around him.
Drippy was exhausted after his long journey in the letter, and he decided that he would take a nap.
There was so much talking going on around him that he began to look for a quiet place.
A man in a uniform opened the door of a computer for a moment, and Drippy thought, that looks like a good place, and he crept inside.
